meta.source: Material Theme Builder export from Fox (light and dark, standard contrast) + Material 3 type, shape and spacing scales; Flutter code: lib/common/app_themes.dart, app_dimensions.dart, app_config.dart

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions (FAB, filled buttons), the selected nav indicator icon, anniversary marks on the calendar.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Selected or emphasized containers, such as the date badge of today's anniversary.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis accents (rarely used; prefer primary).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Navigation drawer active indicator, selected segment of the Year/Month/Week switch and of the Settings segmented buttons.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Warm accent family behind the "today" highlight.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Background of anniversaries that fall today and of the leap-month question (via today-container). Text on it uses on-tertiary-fixed / on-tertiary-fixed-variant, never on-surface.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Theme Builder role; not used for text on today-container (contrast too low in dark).

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary-container in both themes (the same in light and dark, because the warm container stays light).

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text on tertiary-container in both themes.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Validation messages, the Delete action.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error banners (not used in v1).

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text on error-container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface or surface-container.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: lunar and solar date lines, helper text, inactive nav labels.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Text field borders, dividers that must be visible (3:1).

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar background.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lowest container (rare).

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Anniversary cards, form field fills.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Rarely used; the drawer sits on surface-container-low and dialogs on surface-container-high.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialog and bottom sheet background.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Year/Month/Week switch track, calendar month tiles.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs at 32% opacity.

tokens.name: today-container
tokens.usage: Card background for an anniversary that falls today. Always with on-today-container text and the "Hôm nay" chip, never color alone.

tokens.name: on-today-container
tokens.usage: Main text on today-container.

tokens.name: on-today-container-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary lines on today-container.

tokens.name: anniversary-mark
tokens.usage: Dot under a calendar day that has an anniversary.

tokens.name: holiday-mark
tokens.usage: Dot and lunar number for mùng 1, rằm and Tết festivals on the calendar. Different from anniversary-mark (primary); not the error color.

tokens.name: holiday-container
tokens.usage: Background of a holiday item in the calendar day list.

tokens.name: on-holiday-container
tokens.usage: Text on holiday-container.

tokens.name: feedback-success
tokens.usage: Background of a success notice (snackbar, flushbar). Flutter: NotifyColorExtension (context.notifyColorScheme).

tokens.name: on-feedback-success
tokens.usage: Text and icon on feedback-success. Flutter: NotifyColorExtension (context.notifyColorScheme).

tokens.name: feedback-warning
tokens.usage: Background of a warning notice. Flutter: NotifyColorExtension (context.notifyColorScheme).

tokens.name: on-feedback-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icon on feedback-warning. Flutter: NotifyColorExtension (context.notifyColorScheme).

tokens.name: feedback-info
tokens.usage: Background of an information notice. Flutter: NotifyColorExtension (context.notifyColorScheme).

tokens.name: on-feedback-info
tokens.usage: Text and icon on feedback-info. Flutter: NotifyColorExtension (context.notifyColorScheme).

tokens.name: feedback-error
tokens.usage: Background of an error notice (not form validation, which uses error). Flutter: NotifyColorExtension (context.notifyColorScheme).

tokens.name: on-feedback-error
tokens.usage: Text and icon on feedback-error. Flutter: NotifyColorExtension (context.notifyColorScheme).

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: Big day number on a future detail screen.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Form and dialog titles, month name in the calendar.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Person's name on a card, reminder time value.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Section labels such as "Hôm nay", "Sắp tới".

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Form inputs, dialog text, empty-state text.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Lunar and solar date lines on cards.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Weekday headers, tags ("Ngày giỗ", "Ngày lễ"), "ngày nữa", field captions.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Lunar day under a calendar date.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card between lines and between chips.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen margin on phones (M3 compact) and card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between form sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Top padding of the empty state.

tokens.name: corner-none
tokens.usage: Not used in v1.

tokens.name: corner-extra-small
tokens.usage: Text fields and field-like pickers (date, month, time).

tokens.name: corner-small
tokens.usage: Chips.

tokens.name: corner-medium
tokens.usage: Cards, calendar event items, date badge, month tiles, the today and selected day in the month grid.

tokens.name: corner-large
tokens.usage: FAB.

tokens.name: corner-extra-large
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: corner-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented buttons (Settings and the Năm/Tháng/Tuần switch), drawer indicator, switches, the "Hôm nay" chip.

size.note: Material 3 component sizes used by Evermoon (dp).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable size for anything interactive.

tokens.name: top-app-bar
tokens.usage: Small top app bar height.

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: Floating action button size.

tokens.name: text-field
tokens.usage: Text field container height.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Button container height; the touch target stays 48.

tokens.name: date-badge-width
tokens.usage: Lunar date badge width on a card.

tokens.name: date-badge-height
tokens.usage: Lunar date badge height on a card.

tokens.name: navigation-drawer-width
tokens.usage: Modal navigation drawer width (M3 allows up to 360).

tokens.name: drawer-item
tokens.usage: Navigation drawer destination height.

tokens.name: switch-width
tokens.usage: Switch track width.

tokens.name: switch-height
tokens.usage: Switch track height.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Filter chip height (touch target stays 48).

shadow.note: Material 3 elevation levels. M3 shows depth mainly with tonal surface-container colors; shadows only where a component spec has one. Flutter: AppElevation (dp) and the Material widget defaults.

tokens.name: elevation-level-0
tokens.usage: Flat: filled and outlined cards, app bar at rest (depth comes from surface-container colors).

tokens.name: elevation-level-1
tokens.usage: 1 dp: elevated card, modal bottom sheet, modal navigation drawer.

tokens.name: elevation-level-2
tokens.usage: 3 dp: menus, app bar while content scrolls under it.

tokens.name: elevation-level-3
tokens.usage: 6 dp: FAB at rest, dialogs, snackbar.

tokens.name: elevation-level-4
tokens.usage: 8 dp: FAB hovered or focused.

tokens.name: elevation-level-5
tokens.usage: 12 dp: not used in v1.
